Author: The Enceladeum
Name: HOutfits
Punchline: Apply full sets, loose pieces, facewear and weapons to your character in Glamourer with a single click.
Description: Browse the game's named sets, sets recovered by item name, every other wearable piece, facewear and weapons, with large icon previews on hover, and apply a whole set or any single piece to your character through Glamourer, instead of picking each item from a dropdown.
Changelog: 1.3.0: New Faces tab puts the faces only NPCs have on your character (Hythlodaeus's, 2B's and many more), which Glamourer's own face menu doesn't offer. Looks lists each distinct look, faces made for your body first; Full head also copies hair and colours. Parts changes one feature at a time (eyebrows, eyes, nose, jaw, mouth, facial features, face paint) from NPCs who share your face. Values character creation doesn't offer are shown in gold.
